thread:
maria: Quick sync — running the quarterly access review for temp/admin roles and noticed owner evidence missing for ~15 identities. Also seeing gaps in KMS audit events around 2026-05-14 02:00-03:30 UTC. Anyone familiar with retention/ingest for that window?

sam: ugh. that window was when we had the storage node upgrade. could be logship lag or retention TTL. i can dig.

ash: the storage node work had a flaky tailer, we added retries but not backfilled at the time. we should check BigQuery (audit_logs.kms_events) and the raw GCS bucket.

raul: adding quick queries. start with BQ to see counts:```sql
SELECT event_name, COUNT(*)
FROM `redwood-telemetry.audit_logs.kms_events`
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-05-14T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-05-14T03:30:00Z'
GROUP BY event_name;
```
If counts are 0 for some namespaces then check raw_gcs.kms-archive/* for that date.

maria: thanks. the missing owner evidence holds up a few entitlement removals (we need confirmed owner before we revoke). can we backfill?

jen: i've started a replay job request to infra. ops-bot, can you confirm if a replay is possible for that GCS range?

ops-bot: replay_job_created id=rp-20260514-01 status=queued (requested by jen). ETA ~ 4h. Note: files older than 90d may require cold retrieval. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: if replay succeeds we should re-run the owner-evidence collector against those events. collector job: `tools/ownerproof/collect --since 2026-05-14T02:00 --until 2026-05-14T03:30 --roles temp_admin,svc_admin`

maria: ok plan A = replay + re-collect. Plan B if replay fails?

ash: plan B: fall back to linked service logs (service X wrote KMS grants at the time). cross-check CloudTrail-like entries and vault access. also reach out to teams who held those grants - they often keep PRs/timestamps.

raul: i can automate cross-check with PR metadata: quick script to join `org/repos` PR merge times with grant timestamps to produce candidate owners.

kyle: FYI, we also saw a related alert from vulnerability team about stale admin keys for one of those accounts. if evidence can't be produced we should consider temporary disable + just-in-time escalation flow.

maria: agree. we can't leave stale admin keys around. action items: 1) ops replay (jen) 2) re-run ownerproof collector (sam) 3) PR cross-check automation (raul) 4) if no evidence, start temp-disable + JIT flow (kyle).

sam: assigned. i'll post collector job link when done. i will also run a quick query to show which identities are blocked by missing evidence:```sql
SELECT ident, role, required_evidence, evidence_found
FROM entitlement.review_queue
WHERE scan_tag='2026-q2' AND evidence_found = FALSE
ORDER BY role;
```

jen: replay job updated: rp-20260514-01 status=running. copying infra play: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/log-replay

security-bot: [automated] Incident INC-2026-174 created: "Access-review evidence gap due to log ingestion window" assigned to eng-security.

maria: noted INC id. please add any followups in that incident. also we need an audit log note for compliance: we have to record why evidence is missing and remediation plan.

raul: i pushed a thin PoC to generate candidate owner list from PR metadata — will link after tests.

ops-bot: replay_job rp-20260514-01 completed: status=success, files_replayed=3,842, bytes=4.1GB, backfilled_range=2026-05-14T02:00:00Z..2026-05-14T03:30:00Z

sam: collector run finished: 44 events materialized, 11 previously-missing owner proofs recovered. updating entitlement queue.

maria: great. who are the remaining 4 identities still missing evidence? can we get manual attestations?

kyle: list from the queue (redacted) — two are service accounts with orphaned owners, one is a human account on leave, one is external contractor. for the human/contractor we should ask direct manager and vendor ops. for orphaned service accounts, target rotation and limit access.

jen: started outreach emails to managers and vendor-ops. templated message in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/owner-attestation-template

maria: for compliance record: i'll note that root cause = log ingestion delay from storage node upgrade + no automatic replay failover. remediation: (a) add end-to-end replay healthcheck (b) auto-create incident if replayable gaps exceed 5m for entitlement-related events (c) shorten retention TTL mismatch docs.

ash: +1. i'll file infra PR for the healthcheck metric: `logs.replay.lag_seconds` threshold 300 -> trigger incident.

raul: also adding a small augment to the collector to cross-reference PR metadata automatically so we have a second-evidence stream.

maria: excellent. final steps: update INC-2026-174 with remediation, attach owner proofs we recovered, and schedule a brief postmortem next week. i'll draft notes.

sam: done — added recovered proofs and linked the collector run id cr-20260514-22.

maria: thanks team. :thumbsup: we should close the entitlement removals until all missing evidence either recovered or manual-attested. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes.

security-bot: reminder: quarterly access review deadline 2026-06-01.

maria: noted. will sync postmortem by 2026-05-21.

jen: closing loop — replay + collector restored most evidence, inbox outreach in progress.

kyle: i'll start the JIT flow template in case attestation fails for the contractor.

maria: thanks all.
